ability.infinity.reality_stone.paint_wor: Reality becomes a canvas. Left (aimed): the exposed surface within 9 blocks of the aimed point is repainted in a spreading wave under layered red rune circles, with the palette chosen with Alt+scroll: Candy, Gold, Crystal or Crimson. Right: wipe your paint now. It lasts 60 s and then washes off from the outside in; every block returns with its exact original state (anything broken or replaced meanwhile is never touched). Painted blocks drop nothing (no free items), and logs, leaves, ores, chests and unbreakable blocks are left out. Only with mobGriefing on and where the player may build. One paint per player.
infinity.extra.paint.none: You have no paint on the world
infinity.extra.paint.busy: Your paint is still on the world (right click to wipe it)
infinity.extra.paint.griefing: mobGriefing is off: the world cannot be painted
infinity.wheel.dual.paint_world: Left: paint the world  ·  Right: wipe the paint
ability.infinity.reality_stone.pocket_ca: Left (aimed): you throw a spinning red card that homes in on the aimed creature; where it lands the creature shrinks and is sealed for 8 s in a floating red box with a galaxy of stars inside, over a rune circle. Right: the cards come back and all your boxes open now. Bosses and allies cannot be caged, a creature can only be in one box and you can have up to 3 boxes. Deals no damage and touches no block.
infinity.extra.card.caged: You were sealed in a pocket universe
infinity.wheel.dual.pocket_card: Left: throw the card at the target  ·  Right: open all boxes
ability.infinity.soul_stone.soul_sight.d: Toggle. While on, every living soul around you (radius 16–64 with Alt+scroll) burns with an orange outline that shows through walls, wisps rise from their heads and you hear every heartbeat: deep for the big ones, quick for the wounded, a ghostly whisper for the undead. It is all private: nobody else sees or hears it, nothing changes in the world and the creatures' real teams are given back when it turns off.
ability.infinity.soul_stone.lost_lantern: The first use lights a floating soul lantern at your shoulder. It gathers the soul of every creature that dies within 32 blocks of it (up to 24; it also takes the ones that died in the last 30 s around you). Left (aimed): releases the whole lantern as a homing swarm: each soul hits for 3.5 and seeks the next enemy if its prey dies. Right: the souls rush into you and your allies as healing and a golden shield; with an empty lantern, right puts it out. No block is touched; it vanishes if you die or log out.
infinity.extra.lantern.on: The Lantern of the Lost is lit
infinity.extra.lantern.bless: %s souls heal you and your allies
infinity.wheel.dual.lost_lantern: Left: release the swarm  ·  Right: heal with the souls / put out
ability.infinity.time_stone.rewind_me.de: While you carry the Time Stone your last 6 s are remembered (position, view, health, hunger, fire). Left: you rewind 5 s: in about a second you fly backwards along your own footsteps, leaving green afterimages, over a reversed clock, and arrive with the health, hunger and fire you had then (never less than now) and no harmful effects. Right: a quick 1.5 s blink back to dodge. Resistance protects you on the trip. Nothing else in the world is touched. The memory clears on death, dimension change, logout and after each rewind.
infinity.extra.rewind.nothing: There is no past to go back to yet (move a little)
infinity.wheel.dual.rewind_me: Left: rewind 5 s  ·  Right: rewind 1.5 s
Left: two copies of you step out of a green rift from 3 s in the future, wearing your armour and holding your weapon, and fight at your side for 20 s. Whenever YOU hit something they blink next to it in a flash of time and echo the blow (60% of your damage each) a moment later. Right: send the clones back. Clones are green-glowing allies (they never hurt you or your allies, drop nothing and give no experience); a new cast replaces the pair.
infinity.extra.clones.gone: The clones return to the future
infinity.extra.clones.on: Your clones arrive from the future
infinity.extra.clones.name: %s's clone
infinity.wheel.dual.time_clones: Left: call the clones  ·  Right: send them away
ability.infinity.time_stone.alternate_ti: Conjunction Time + Reality (with the Reality Stone on you). Left: opens a ghost world around you (radius 8–20 with Alt+scroll) for 10 s under a red and green dome. Inside, everything may be destroyed (digging, TNT, creepers), because when the time is over (or you use it again) every broken block flies back into place from the inside out with its original state (only where the spot is empty: builds made meanwhile are never overwritten). To keep it dupe-free: blocks broken inside drop nothing, falling blocks do not form, items thrown by explosions vanish and no loose item can be picked up until the end. Chests and other block entities are immune in the zone. One zone per player.
infinity.extra.timeline.need_reality: You need the Reality Stone with you
